Name: JP's Utility Machines - Super Outdoor Lampposts -
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ff00][u][center]Super Outdoor Lamps[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][b][i]Because illuminating the night with colored lights is just great![/i][/b][/size][/color]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]In Robin's store you will find several recipes to make your own basic lampposts, and a machine to recharge the used battery packs. You can also buy more powerful lampposts or special lampposts that you can modify to your liking. [/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]There are 10 colors available for each lampposts, and 3 special lampposts that you can modify every aspect of it from the Generic Mod Config Menu. [/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[list]
[*][size=4]Standard Lamppost: Similar range to game lamppost. 10 colors available, requires one battery pack and lasts 2 days. [/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*]Super Lamppost: The range is three times greater than the game lamppost. 10 colors available, requires one battery pack and lasts 2 days. 
[/list]
[list]
[*]Generic Lampposts: They can be modified through the Generic Mod Config Menu. You can modify their range, color and duration to your liking. There are 3 available.
[/list][/size]
[color=#ffff00][size=5][i]I had the idea of adding skins for the lampposts using Alternative Textures but due to lack of time it was not possible. If anyone is interested in the project is free to make and publish their modifications of this mod. Anyway I hope you enjoy the mod.[/i][/size][/color]

[b][i][color=#ff7700][size=6]You can make and publish your translations without asking for permission![/size][/color][/i][/b]
